prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1037; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in on a street in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give the information about the accident, if that's alright.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened leading up to the collision?

A: I was stopped at a red light in the right lane. Traffic was moving slowly. The light turned green, and I had just started to accelerate when I felt a hard impact from behind.

Q: Where were you headed, and what kind of vehicle were you driving?

A: I was driving my sedan and heading toward the shopping center on the east side. The impact pushed my car forward into the intersection.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No. I checked my mirror when I stopped, but I didn't see anything close behind me. I didn't have any warning.

Q: After the collision, did you get out of the vehicle or speak with the other driver?

A: I got out briefly, but I felt dizzy and sore, so I sat back down. The other driver came over and said he was looking at his phone.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same afternoon. They diagnosed me with a neck strain and a lower back strain. I've been given muscle relaxers and told to do physical therapy.

Q: How are your symptoms today?

A: The neck pain is constant, especially when I turn my head to check traffic. My lower back is stiff in the morning and aches when I sit for long periods. Some days I've had trouble sleeping.

Q: Are you currently missing any work because of these injuries?

A: I've been limited to light duties for the past few weeks, and I've missed a couple of shifts.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm still trying to recover, and I'd appreciate a prompt response on the claim.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
